  • Description
  • Specifications

JOOLA and Perseus have become synonymous with performance, and the Perseus Heat Vision 16mm builds on that legacy with enhancements that help players maximize their unique play style. The powerful Perseus shape now features JOOLA’s SK Film, positioned between the paddle’s surface and core to reduce vibration and unwanted feedback. Heat Vision also incorporates thermoforming from the paddle’s handle through the neck, adding stability and flexibility.

Available in three eye-catching colorways, the Perseus Heat Vision 16mm is USAP PBCoR.43 Certified for tournament play.

Shape: Perseus | Core: 16mm | Surface: Textured Carbon Fiber | Weight: ~7.8 oz | Grip: 5.5" length / 4.25" circumference | USAP Certified: Yes
